messages:
Elise: Quick sync — we need to decide sequencing and launch gates for Private Deploy v2 (on-prem packaging + customer-managed networking). Can we land a decision by EOD Wed?
Nana: Suggest splitting packaging and networking. Packaging (installer, upgrade, preflight) is broader and lower-risk; networking (private endpoints, peering, NAT) is higher-touch and security-heavy.
Devin: Agree split. Packaging can ship with a sane default network (cluster-ip / nodeport) while we iterate on VPC patterns.
Simon: SRE note: packaging-first reduces ops overhead. Networking requires multi-cloud testing matrix and stubs for degraded network.
Maria: From customers: Big bank wants private endpoints + HSM; medtech can take packaging first but will need air-gap later. So commercial urgency varies.
Elise: Proposed phased plan: Phase A = on-prem package + standard KMS adapters; Phase B = customer-managed networking (PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, documented peering); Phase C = air-gapped/offline installer. Thoughts?
Nana: Phase A scope: helm chart + plain manifests, preflight checks, upgrade compatibility shim, rollback hooks, operator docs. Estimate ~3 sprints for core work.
Devin: Upgrade approach: rolling in-place with compatibility layer. Provide migration tool: `rwd-migrate --from v1 --to v2 --dry-run`. Also keep immutable image tags.
Simon: Must include canary rollout (default 10%), synthetic smoke checks, auto-fallback to hosted model on regression. Add tracing / perf alarms before 100% cutover.
Maria: Customer acceptance checklist to publish: supported k8s versions, kernel min, required CNI, IAM policies for VPC endpoints, expected downtime window for upgrades.
Elise: Let's write 4 clear launch criteria for Phase A so sales/CS can gate pilots.
Nana: My Phase A gates: 1) Installer runs end-to-end on a vanilla k8s cluster and preflight passes. 2) Rolling upgrade validated on staging with zero data loss. 3) KMS integration tested (rotation + restore). 4) Operator guide + runbook published.
Devin: For Phase B gates: 1) Private endpoint patterns (AWS PrivateLink / GCP equivalents) documented + tested. 2) Terraform module for peering automation with examples. 3) Routing/NAT patterns and troubleshooting notes.
Simon: Add operational gates: incident runbook for network partition, dashboards for p95 latency, KV hit rate, model-fallback rate, and automated synthetic checks in CI.
Elise: Risk register quick hits?
Nana: Risk: runtime kernel incompatibilities during migration. Mitigation: compatibility shim and feature flag.
Devin: Risk: cloud-specific networking edge cases. Mitigation: prototype terraform + minimal supported patterns for GA (limit scope).
Simon: Risk: KMS/HSM differences. Mitigation: adapter layer + test harness for AWS/GCP/Azure keys.
Maria: Sales note: Customer A (finance) will block until Phase B features are available. Customer B (healthcare) will pilot Phase A and request air-gap timeline.
Elise: That implies Phase A is highest reach; Phase B is enterprise-sell. We should scope PS + SLA offering for Phase B pilots.
Nana: Dependencies: eng-runtime for shim, eng-infra for terraform module, docs for installer guides. If runtime shim slips >2 sprints, mark packaging as blocked.
Devin: I'll prototype terraform module and examples this sprint; will open PR by Friday. Also will add sample route/NAT configs.
Simon: I'll add SRE playbooks, monitoring dashboards, and chaos tests (net partition) to the private-deploy repo.
Maria: I'll line up legal security review with Customer A and prepare pilot onboarding checklist (preflight items + contacts).
ops-bot: CI job created: private-deploy-installer-smoke (nightly). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/2468 :robot_face:
Elise: Timeline suggestion: Phase A alpha week 6, beta w/ pilots week 10, GA week 14. Phase B prototype in parallel, pilot for Customer A ~week 12.
Nana: I'll own packaging + upgrade test plan and deliver by Fri.
Devin: Confirmed — networking prototype + terraform examples by end of sprint.
Simon: Confirmed — SRE playbooks and synth tests.
Maria: Confirmed — customer pilot coordination and legal loop-in.
Elise: I'll draft a short PRD with the phase gates and SLA/PS options, and schedule a follow-up sync next Wed. Thanks all! :tada:
